name: Iron Hand
rulesText:
**If you are Imperial, discard Iron Hand.**

**SETUP:** If you were in the previous game, you place one warband on all sites coming from the Atlas until the Empire divider, and players may place their pawn at any site.

**CHRONICLE:** Score your legacies in addition to the winner, and perform Shape Empire and Build Edifice (Throne). Your sites are stored in place of the Empire (Stars).

name: Chronicler
rulesText: **CHRONICLE (SUN):** After Resolve Legacies, you may declare that all players score their legacies now. _Each legacy may only be scored once per game._

name: Steadfast
rulesText: **CHRONICLE:** Your other legacies **cannot** become dormant—they always stay active.

name: Peacemaker
rulesText: **ACTION:** Return a banner you hold to the shared bank. _Do not adjust its [favor] or [secret]._ If you do, remove all warbands except the last _(including bandits)_ from each site and player board, even yours.

name: The Needle
rulesText: After you take a banner in any way, you may flip it to its other side.

name: Circle of Swords
rulesText: **SETUP:** You gain eight starting warbands _(instead of three)_. If you're Imperial and other Imperials would gain fewer than three, you gain less.

name: Great Architect
rulesText: **IF YOU ARE AN IMPERIAL:** **CHRONICLE (THRONE):** You perform Build Edifice and may build any edifice _(not just a matching one)_. Do this even if the Iron Hand is in play.

name: Ancestral Lands
rulesText: **IF YOU ARE AN IMPERIAL:** **TRAVEL:** Traveling to the Cradle costs you only 1 Supply.

name: Scepter Bearer
rulesText: **IF YOU ARE AN IMPERIAL:** **SETUP:** You start with the Grand Scepter _(instead of the Chancellor)_.

name: Royal Line
rulesText: **IF YOU ARE A CITIZEN:** **CHRONICLE (SUN):** You may choose which Imperial meets the Successor goal. _Ignore the printed goal. You may choose no one._

name: Keeper of Order
rulesText: **IF YOU ARE AN IMPERIAL:** **BATTLE PLAN:** If your enemy is an Imperial, ±2 [attack-die] and you ignore all [skull] you roll when attacking.

name: Golden Key
rulesText: **IF YOU ARE AN IMPERIAL:** You may always peek at the Reliquary. **ACTION:** Burn [secret-burnt] [favor-burnt] to take a relic from the Reliquary.

name: World Crafter
rulesText: **SETUP:** For the Imperial Maps foundation, you fill site slots, using any mix of Recent and Forgotten Sites _(after resolving the Rival legacy)_. For the Wide Horizons foundation, when anyone explores, you fill the slot with a Recent or Forgotten Site.

name: Matchmaker
rulesText: Whenever players draw legacies from the deck and choose one to keep, you draw and choose for them instead. _The Amber Doors edifice does not trigger this._

name: Revolutionary
rulesText: **CHRONICLE (THRONE):** After Build Edifice, you may discard any number of denizens at Imperial sites.

name: Populist
rulesText: **SETUP:** When setting up the favor banks, you may choose to divide the favor among the banks evenly. If you do, take any remainder. _For example, dividing 19 favor among the banks leaves you one favor._

name: Rival
rulesText:
**CHRONICLE (THRONE):** In Shape Empire, you may prevent any number of denizens from being discarded.

**IF YOU ARE AN EXILE:** **SETUP:** Before resolving foundations, fill the three Cradlemost empty site slots using the Empire setup rules, but place one warband of yours on each _(not an Imperial warband)_. You may place your pawn on these sites.

name: The Standard Bearer
rulesText: **SETUP:** After placing your pawn, you may take a banner from the shared bank and place two more [favor] or [secret] on it from the shared bank.

name: The Ear
rulesText: **ACTION:** You may peek at the relics at any site. **CHRONICLE (THRONE):** In Scatter Relics, you examine the relics and choose which sites they go to.

name: Heirloom
rulesText: **CHRONICLE (THRONE):** Before Scatter Relics, secretly choose one of your relics to keep facedown. You will start the next game with it.

name: High Priest
rulesText: **ACTION:** If you have the Darkest Secret, you may move any number of [secret] from the Darkest Secret to your player board. **WHEN NEGOTIATING:** You may give [secret].

name: Seer
rulesText: **SETUP:** When building the world deck, peek at the Visions and secretly place them in any positions.

name: Arbiter
rulesText: **END OF ROUND:** Before the end die is rolled, you may choose to modify the roll by −1 to +3.

name: The Bright Beacon
rulesText: **CHRONICLE (BEACON):** If you're resolving the Beacon, you may take any six cards from the Dispossessed _(instead of choosing suits and taking from their matching dividers)_.

name: Oaths of Loyalty
rulesText: When you would gain a starting adviser, bury it, except for—**CHRONICLE (WORLD):** In Gather Denizens, keep your faceup advisers. They will be your facedown starting advisers in the next game.

name: Conspirator
rulesText: **WAKE:** On your first turn, secretly write down which round the game will end on and who will win. If you are correct, you win instead. _This even beats a Successor win._

name: Light Fingers
rulesText: **WAKE:** When you Take Wealth, you may take [favor] or [secret] from your site even if enemy pawns are there.

name: Secret Society
rulesText: **SETUP:** Before building the world deck, you may secretly choose a Vision except the Conspiracy to take as a facedown adviser _(discard excess advisers)_. If you do, advance the Visions Drawn marker once.

name: Ruthless
rulesText: **ACTION:** Burn [favor-burnt] [favor-burnt] to bury a denizen at your site.

name: Quest to Distant Lands
rulesText: **SETUP:** You may choose to not place your pawn. If you do, you may choose one card from the Dispossessed and swap it with a starting adviser or card you drew in Foundation IV. _It is not buried by the Oaths of Loyalty legacy._ **WAKE:** On your first turn, you **must** place your pawn at any site.

name: Wealthy
rulesText: Set Foundation II to Movers and Shakers. **SETUP:** After placing your pawn, take [favor] from two players or take [favor] [favor] [favor] from the shared bank.

name: Gatekeeper
rulesText: Set Foundation III to Public Ambitions. **CHRONICLE (SUN):** Before players resolve legacies, you may take one active legacy from an enemy if you meet its goal.

name: Beloved
rulesText: Set Foundation IV to Teeming World. **WHEN TRADING:** You may trade with advisers held by other players whose pawns are at your site.

name: The Mouth
rulesText: Set Foundation VI to Festival. **ACTION:** Burn [favor-burnt] [favor-burnt] to activate a dormant legacy if you meet its goal. _You can even activate legacies in the Public Ambitions foundation._

name: Reformer
rulesText: Set Foundation V to Grand Council. **CHRONICLE (START OF THRONE):** If you won, you may move and swap denizens at sites you rule, ignoring the locked restriction.

name: Pathfinder
rulesText: Set Foundation I to Wide Horizons. **TRAVEL:** You may ignore the Mountain, Island, and Pass powers.
